apple.err.auto_unsupported: --auto currently supports macOS only (Safari / Google Chrome)
apple.err.not_running: Music.app is not running (capy play starts it): {err}
auth.err.google_client: Google rejected this client ID / secret (invalid_client)
auth.err.google_grant: the Google refresh token is no longer valid
auth.err.google_scope: the Google authorization is missing drive.appdata (on the consent screen, tick "See, create, and delete its own configuration data in your Google Drive"); run capy auth login google again
canon.err.schema_too_new: the files on Drive use a newer schema than this capy; run capy update first
cmd.config.get.short: Print a setting (an empty line if unset)
cmd.config.list.short: List all settings (key	value when not a TTY)
cmd.config.set.short: Change a setting (settable: default_provider, local_root, language)
cmd.config.short: Read and write non-secret settings (config.json; credentials always stay in the keychain)
config.err.apple_storefront: apple_storefront comes from your account during capy auth login apple and can't be set by hand
config.err.broken:
{err}
The config file is broken and can't be fixed in place. If you're sure you want to discard its settings, delete the file and run config set and auth login again
config.err.spotify_client_id: change spotify_client_id with capy auth login spotify (a new client ID needs a new authorization too)
config.hint.default_provider: Tip: `capy config set default_provider {id}` makes {id} the default platform (no need to pass --provider after that)
config.language.unknown: language {value} in config.json is not supported; using {default} for now (supported: {valid}; capy config set language <code>)
dedup.err.restricted_playlist: can't read this playlist's tracks — it may be someone else's playlist you follow (since 2026-02 Spotify only returns their metadata, spec §1.1), or the authorization may be insufficient; run capy doctor to check
drive.err.api_not_enabled: the Google Drive API is not enabled in your Google Cloud project
drive.err.not_logged_in: not logged in to Google — run capy auth login google first
drive.err.storage_quota: your Google Drive is full, so nothing can be uploaded (reading and dry runs still work); free up some space and try again
escape.err.nothing_local: there is no canonical data on this machine (state.db is missing or empty)
provider.err.bad_isrc: invalid ISRC (must be 12 letters or digits)
provider.err.not_supported: this platform doesn't support this operation
provider.err.restricted: the platform doesn't provide this content
provider.err.volume_not_allowed: this device doesn't allow remote volume control
store.err.no_db: there is no state.db on this machine
store.err.schema_mismatch: this machine's state.db has a different schema version from this capy
web.err.prompt_timeout: timed out waiting for an answer
